task_summary: Unit-test fixture proves destructive command warning shape stays warning-only.
risk_summary: Destructive command pattern remains advisory and does not emit continue=false.
action_taken: Kept unit regression coverage for warning-only destructive commands.
note: Synthetic regression only; not counted as real burn-in evidence.

task_summary: Captured a real PreToolUse large-output warning during harness sample collection and used the warning to narrow later evidence-gathering commands.
risk_summary: The warning correctly identified likely excessive search output; shared evidence must stay bounded and avoid raw command output.
action_taken: Kept raw warning details out of shared docs and converted the event into a bounded sample candidate.
Switched follow-up collection to focused queue, capture-card, review-card, and checker commands instead of broad unbounded searches.
note: Accepted real-tool-call warning sample from a bounded harness collection run; it proves only warning usefulness for large-output command planning, not blocking readiness.

task_summary: Captured a real PreToolUse sensitive-output warning while applying a bounded governance-doc patch.
risk_summary: The warning was a false positive for this patch because the change only updated bounded sample-count text and did not print secrets or environment values.
action_taken: Reviewed the patch content as bounded governance text before continuing.
Recorded the false-positive classification so future threshold discussions include reviewer cost, not only true-positive warnings.
note: Accepted real PreToolUse false-positive sample; keep advisory until broader warning diversity and reviewer-cost evidence exist.
